text:
Sanjay Rao: Heads up — Datadog reached out about a coordinated launch for our OpenTelemetry/OTLP support in Redwood Private. They want a marketplace listing + curated dashboards + a short joint announcement. Target timeline they proposed: assets ready by Apr 10, announcement week of Apr 17. Who can own each piece?
Maria Lopez: I can take the marketplace listing content and sample runbook. Need product copy + a couple screenshots.
Alex Kim: I'll own dashboards and sample queries. Can we get a test cluster with metrics + traces?
Jen Park: I can handle the announcement copy with Marketing, but need legal sign-off on the partner co-branding blurb.
Taylor (eng-ml): For telemetry, we should confirm which signals we ship by default from Private: traces, logs (optional), and metrics. Also need an example OTLP collector config for our docs.
Sanjay Rao: @Maria @Alex @Jen @Taylor — thanks. Ops: do we have a reproducible Private cluster with OTLP ingestion and a small demo workload? @ops-bot any envs? :eyes:
ops-bot: We have a sandbox pvt-otel-qa in eu-west-1 (credentials: team-otel). Can grant access to this thread's participants.
Alex Kim: grabbing creds. Will spin up a sample app that emits traces + metrics and wire to Datadog agent. Plan to capture: latency p95, tokenization time, inference errors.
Maria Lopez: For the marketplace listing, should emphasize: VPC-friendly, KMS-compatible, no egress of customer telemetry to hosted service, and Datadog-ready dashboards. Can we get a short security statement from Security?
Sanjay Rao: Loop in Legal & Security. @LegalBot can you review the co-announcement TOS snippet?
LegalBot: Flagged for review. Expected turn-around 48 hours. Please attach draft copy when ready.
Taylor (eng-ml): Draft OTLP collector snippet below for docs (someone please sanity-check):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Jen Park: That looks good. Marketing prefers the dashboard screenshots at 1200x800 and a short 1-paragraph customer benefit line. I'll draft the joint blog and send for review by Apr 5.
Alex Kim: ETA for dashboards: Apr 3 to have polished widgets and example notebooks.
Maria Lopez: I'll draft the marketplace listing by Apr 4 and include the runbook. Need a list of 3 sample AR/ROI bullet points — any perf numbers we can share?
Taylor (eng-ml): We can share: 2x latency reduction at 512 tokens with KV caching, 30% token-cost reduction using prefix cache in typical chat workloads. Use sanitized bench numbers — I'll send bullet copy.
Sanjay Rao: Great. Quick checklist and owners:
- Marketplace listing (copy + screenshots + runbook) — Maria
- Dashboards + example queries — Alex
- OTLP docs + collector config — Taylor
- Joint blog + PR plan — Jen + Marketing
- Legal review & co-branding agreement — LegalBot
- Sandbox testing & creds — ops-bot
Also need a joint announcement timeline and press contact. Datadog asked for a dry-run on Apr 12.
Maria Lopez: I'll create a calendar invite for Apr 12 10am PT and share an agenda: run through dashboards, walk the marketplace listing, and review blog draft.
Jen Park: I'll prepare the PR/press list draft and attach to the invite.
Alex Kim: For the demo, I'll prepare a short script: 1) baseline inference w/o cache, 2) enable KV/prefix cache, 3) show telemetry in Datadog (traces + APM view).
Taylor (eng-ml): Important: in Private we must document that OTLP data stays in customer's VPC and exporting to Datadog requires explicit config + API key. We should include a security note and sample KMS flow.
Maria Lopez: Copy that — will add security blurb in listing and runbook.
Sanjay Rao: Any blockers?
Alex Kim: Need a small quota bump on sandbox GPUs for demo workloads. Ops, can we get +2 GPUs for Apr 1–14 window?
ops-bot: Noted. Request submitted to infra; ETA 24–48h.
LegalBot: Please post the draft co-announcement text in this thread when available. Will prioritize.
Jen Park: Draft will be posted by EOD Apr 3.
Sanjay Rao: OK — action items in thread. Thanks everyone. Ping here once you upload drafts/screenshots. :rocket:
